title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 528  An Act Converting the Ducligan Barangay High School in the Municipality of Banaue, Province of Ifugao, Into a National High School to Be Known as the Banaue National High School.
title.orig: Batas Pambansa Blg. 528  An Act Converting the Ducligan Barangay High School in the Municipality of Banaue, Province of Ifugao, Into a National High School to Be Known as the Banaue National High School.
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Ducligan Barangay tại Thị trấn Banaue, Tỉnh Ifugao thành Trường Trung học Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Banaue Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Ducligan Barangay ในเทศบาล Banaue จังหวัด Ifugao เป็น โรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Banaue แห่งชาติ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sekolah Menengah Ducligan Barangay di Kotamadya Banaue, Provinsi Ifugao menjadi Sekolah Menengah Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Banaue Nasional
title.ms: Akta menukar status Sekolah Menengah Ducligan Barangay di Perbandaran Banaue, Wilayah Ifugao kepada Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Banaue Kebangsaan

text.en:
The Ducligan Barangay High School in the Municipality of Banaue, Province of Ifugao, is
hereby converted into a national high school to be known as the Banaue National High School.

The operation of said school for the current fiscal year shall continue to be funded out of local
funds and from its share of national aid to local schools. The requirements for succeeding fiscal years shall be
provided in the forthcoming General Appropriations Acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 10, 1983
